subject: Implementation MAP + Stabilization Runway for Aurora Solar
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@aurorasolar.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@aurorasolar.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP draft attached

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Attached is our initial MAP sketch (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) — it's light on owners and dates, and we'd appreciate Redwood's suggested sequencing and ownership. Two things are high priority for Aurora:

- A hard go-live window the week of July 14 (we have a marketing push)
- KV cache / latency targets for document ingestion (we'll bring SRE to the next call)

Can Redwood propose a 90-day stabilization runway and call out the minimal acceptance criteria we should plan against?

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (sheets: milestones, owners, dependencies)

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Lang
Senior Product Manager, Aurora Solar
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@aurorasolar.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP draft attached

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the MAP. I pulled it into a working copy and sketched a proposed 12-week runway with clear owners and acceptance gates (see attached SOW_draft_Aurora.docx & the refreshed MAP sheet). High level:

1) Week 0–2: Provisioning & credentials
   - Owner (Redwood infra): Ben Carter
   - Deliverable: VPC peering + KMS key exchange; test ingress

2) Week 3–6: Model onboarding + latency validation
   - Owner (Redwood MLops): Karthik Iyer
   - Deliverable: model variants in staging; KV cache baseline tests

3) Week 7–10: Integration & app acceptance
   - Owner (Aurora): Sophie / Carlos; Redwood SEs: Marissa
   - Deliverable: end-to-end flows, error budget allocated

4) Week 11–12: Cutover & stabilization window
   - Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 1–2k qps, rolling failover verified, and regression tests passing on sample prompts

Ask: can Aurora confirm which internal team will own user-acceptance tests (UAT) and provide a point of contact for SRE on the latency work? We'll round this into the MAP and share a formal Mutual Action Plan by Monday.

I've attached a marked SOW that captures the staging tasks and owner assignments. If this sequencing looks good I can lock owner assignments and draft weekly checkpoints for the joint war room.

Attachments: SOW_draft_Aurora.docx (redlines), Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with owners)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@aurorasolar.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP draft attached

Adding some operational detail on the provisioning lane so we have no surprises:

- Week 0 tasks (Ben):
  * Provision dedicated staging cluster (1x A10G equivalent) — target 5/20
  * Request Aurora's CIDR & KMS owner details by 5/19
  * Create test service account and exchange ephemeral key (Doc: redwood-kms-exchange.md)

- Risk: If we don't receive CIDR/KMS access by 5/19, provisioning slides 2 weeks and pushes the go-live into late July.

- Contingency: We can provide a short-lived hosted test plan (no VPC) to decouple the initial validation steps — recommend this if Aurora's infra approvals take longer than 10 business days.

I've dropped a short owner-runbook into the Drive folder (link below) and will follow up with a checklist for the infra handoff call next Tuesday.

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AuroraMAPExample (infra-runbooks)

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@aurorasolar.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@aurorasolar.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP draft attached

Thanks all — this looks reasonable and closer to what we had in mind. A few quick answers:

- UAT owner: Carlos Mendes (Platform) — he'll coordinate with our QA and confirm test plans by 5/21.
- KMS point: I'll ask our security lead to share the KMS contact and required paperwork today — expect that by EOD 5/14.
- We prefer the VPC route but appreciate the hosted fallback if approvals lag.

Next steps:
- Neha: please share the joint weekly checkpoint calendar and the acceptance-gate checklist so we can sync with marketing dates.
- Ben/Karthik: please confirm the target for the first KV cache baseline run (ideally week 4).

I'll confirm internal names on the UAT plan once Carlos reviews. Looking forward to the MAP doc.

Best —
Sophie
Sophie Lang
Senior Product Manager, Aurora Solar
